title: Leyla's wedding and the old customs (paraphrase C)
topic: A family argues about tradition and gender roles before a wedding: Leyla keeps her surname, her father and grandfather defend the old roles, her fiancé cooks, her sister and finally her grandmother take her side
tail_E: For the ceremony in the village, Leyla wears a plain white wedding
target_note: Same target as formulations A and B: 'dress' is the natural continuation of 'Leyla wears a plain white wedding' after ten units about a wedding; the word and its German equivalents (Kleid / Brautkleid) occur nowhere in the units or the tail ('wedding' itself occurs in the units, which is allowed). ' dress' is a single Pythia token (id 7619); Pythia-160m ranks it first after the all-English context (p ~ 0.61, next candidate 'gown' ~ 0.20; pilot check for tail selection only, not a result).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase C of family F15 (wedding and gender roles, Leyla)
notes: Formulation C, domain culture_values: third independent re-phrasing of the ten F15A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same names Leyla and Emre). Replacements include plans her wedding/arranges her wedding (plant/arrangiert), expects a traditional ceremony/anticipates a traditional ceremony (erwartet/rechnet mit), keeps her own surname/sticks with her maiden name (behält ihren Nachnamen/bleibt bei ihrem Mädchennamen), criticises this decision/finds fault with this decision (kritisiert/bemängelt), cooks the feast/makes the feast (kocht das Festessen/macht das Festmahl), argue about old customs/debate old customs (streiten über/debattieren über alte Bräuche), defends the old roles in a long speech/champions the old roles in a lengthy speech (verteidigt/verficht, in einer ausführlichen Rede), supports Leyla/sides with Leyla (unterstützt Leyla/steht auf Leylas Seite), accepts Leyla's choice in the end/approves of Leyla's decision at last (akzeptiert am Ende/billigt zu guter Letzt), the couple celebrates/the newlyweds celebrate (das Paar feiert/die Frischvermählten feiern). 'arrangiert', 'bemängelt', 'debattieren', 'verficht' and 'billigt' are inseparable, 'rechnet mit' and 'bleibt bei' take prepositional objects; no separable verbs ('vorbereiten', 'festhalten', 'eintreten', 'zustimmen', 'nachgeben' avoided). Unit 7 keeps the bare family-register subject 'Grandfather' / 'Großvater' of F15A. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
